jobs.title: BabyQuip — Senior User Experience Designer
jobs.summary: Design across consumer booking and provider operations for a two-sided marketplace reaching ~250K users a month.

bullets.text: Vrbo partner integration: Redesigned the embedded mobile experience across entry, shopping, pricing clarity, and checkout, contributing to +60% entry-to-shopping and +52% entry-to-purchase progression in a matched 30-day GA4 comparison.
Inventory management: Replaced fragmented workflows with a continuous management surface; 68% of providers who rated the redesign were satisfied.
Provider mobile app: Designed BabyQuip’s first provider app, bringing reservations, customer messaging, calendar planning, and urgent operational updates into an on-the-go workflow.

Checkout: Redesigned account identification and checkout to resolve identity earlier, remove repeated steps, and keep renters focused on completing their reservation; mobile checkout completion rose from 76% to 80%.
Packages: Reframed packages into an early-stage discovery layer, enabling standardized package discovery before provider selection.
Served as the sole UX designer for an end-to-end B2B subscription platform, partnering with the CTO and CEO across service setup, scheduling, and booking systems.
Untangled tightly coupled platform behaviors and helped move the product toward a more flexible service-configuration model.
Designed a configurable booking system and shared design patterns supporting multiple business types across provider setup and consumer booking.
Led 0→1 design for administrative and patient-facing decision tools, partnering with PMs and engineers across user management, sales operations, subscription flows, and cost-comparison experiences.
